title: Web Graphic Designer
description:
We're looking for a Web Graphic Designer who understands how to create beautiful, premium creative assets for women's fashion and apparel brands across web, DTC, and Amazon. You will design and support a shoppable website relaunch, produce Amazon product listings and storefronts, and create DTC assets for a portfolio of consumer product brands. One of the primary accounts is an established legwear and hosiery brand with over 55 years of heritage currently relaunching its digital presence.
The most important thing we are looking for is a designer who genuinely understands premium women's fashion creative. This is a clothing brand for women and the work needs to look and feel like it belongs in that world - refined, considered, and visually elevated. Technical execution matters, but aesthetic sensibility matters more. If your portfolio demonstrates that you know how to design for women's apparel and lifestyle brands at a high-end level, Amazon-specific experience is a plus but not a requirement. Strong designers with the right eye and a willingness to learn platform requirements will absolutely be considered.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires availability during US business hours

• Freelance engagement with consistent ongoing work across a diverse consumer product portfolio

• Immediate opportunity on a heritage fashion brand with a DTC website relaunch actively in progress

What You'll Work On
Web Design and DTC Website Support

• Support the design and relaunch of a shoppable DTC website for a heritage women's fashion brand

• Design landing pages, product pages, and site updates in Figma with a premium fashion aesthetic

• Collaborate with the broader team to bring a cohesive visual direction to the new website experience

• Produce web creative assets including banners, promotional graphics, and email marketing visuals

• Apply the same elevated aesthetic across all web touchpoints so the brand experience is consistent from homepage to checkout

Amazon Product Listing Creative

• Design main images, lifestyle imagery, and infographic image stacks for Amazon product listings

• Create stylized, informative product infographics that communicate key benefits clearly and visually

• Apply strong layout, hierarchy, and visual storytelling to every listing image set

• Ensure all assets meet Amazon's technical specifications and content standards

A+ Content and Brand Storytelling

• Design A+ Content modules that tell a compelling brand story and drive conversion

• Structure content flows that guide the customer through the product story logically and visually

• Maintain a premium aesthetic that reflects the brand's positioning and target customer

• A+ Content experience is preferred but not required - strong designers will be trained on platform requirements

Amazon Storefront Design

• Design and update Amazon Brand Storefronts that are visually cohesive and easy to navigate

• Create storefront layouts that showcase the full product range and support cross-sell and upsell

What You Bring

• A portfolio that demonstrates a genuine understanding of premium women's fashion and apparel aesthetics - this is the primary filter for this role

• Web design experience in Figma for DTC or e-commerce sites, including landing pages and product pages

• Experience designing for women's apparel, intimates, shapewear, tights, hosiery, lifestyle brands, or similar fashion-adjacent categories

• A strong, independent design eye with the ability to make strategic creative decisions about layout, storytelling, and visual hierarchy

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop and Illustrator

• Ability to work independently, deliver on time, and communicate clearly throughout every project

title: Analista Funcional PL
description:
A Nordware desenvolve soluções para e-commerces e lojas em marketplaces, sincronizando essas operações ao ERP SAP de forma prática, eficiente e completa - desde a entrada do pedido até a expedição dos itens. Também criamos soluções acessíveis para pequenos e-commerces, integrados com Bling e Tiny, sempre com foco em simplificar processos e impulsionar o crescimento dos nossos clientes.
Como Analista Funcional, você será responsável por analisar demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em especificações funcionais claras para o desenvolvimento. Atua em conjunto com o Product Owner no refinamento de backlog, definição de critérios de aceite e alinhamento com o time técnico. Apoia na estimativa, validação das entregas e garantia de qualidade funcional, além de contribuir com melhorias contínuas e suporte na análise de incidentes.

• Atuar na análise funcional de demandas, transformando necessidades de negócio em especificações claras, estruturadas e compreensíveis para o time técnico

• Elaborar documentações funcionais e técnicas, detalhando fluxos, regras de negócio, integrações, exceções e cenários de uso, com apoio do time de desenvolvimento quando necessário

• Trabalhar em conjunto com o Product Owner no refinamento de backlog, garantindo que as demandas estejam prontas para desenvolvimento (Definition of Ready)

• Interagir com desenvolvedores para avaliar viabilidade técnica, identificar riscos, dependências e possíveis impactos nas soluções existentes

• Conduzir sessões de levantamento de requisitos com stakeholders (internos e/ou externos), garantindo entendimento completo das necessidades

• Definir e documentar critérios de aceite claros e mensuráveis para cada demanda

• Apoiar o time na estimativa de esforço, coletando e consolidando estimativas junto aos desenvolvedores

• Atuar na validação das entregas, realizando testes funcionais e garantindo que o resultado esteja aderente aos critérios de aceite antes da liberação

• Identificar inconsistências, gaps ou oportunidades de melhoria durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento e validação

• Colaborar com o time de suporte na análise de incidentes, contribuindo com diagnóstico funcional e identificação de causas raiz

• Ensino Superior Completo em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência comprovada em levantamento e documentação de requisitos.

• Experiência na tradução de necessidades de negócio para especificações técnicas/funcionais.

• Vivência em processos de modelagem de processos e escrita de cenários de uso.

• Experiência prévia em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum/Kanban).

• Desejável experiência com integração de sistemas e análise de APIs.

• Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de demandas (Jira ou similar).

• Criação de critérios de aceite e execução de testes funcionais.

• Capacidade de análise de impacto e validação de soluções.

• Comunicação técnica para interface entre áreas de negócio e desenvolvedores.

• Modelagem de processos e escrita de especificações funcionais.

• Levantamento e documentação de requisitos.

Será considerado um diferencial se você tiver:

• Conhecimento sobre SAP Business One

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de teste (Postman, Insomnia, etc.)

• Familiaridade com a ferramenta Jira/Confluence

• Familiaridade com a estrutura de e-commerces e/ou marketplaces

Oferecemos ao PJ:

• Trabalho remoto

title: Transitions Manager
company: The Inland Real Estate Group of Companies
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Transitions Manager is responsible for leading the successful onboarding, integration, opening, and disposition of self-storage properties across the company's owned, managed, acquired, and third-party management portfolios. This role serves as the primary point of coordination following due diligence and is accountable for managing all transition activities necessary to ensure a seamless property launch, management takeover, acquisition integration, new development opening, or disposition.
Acting as the central project leader, the Transitions Manager works closely with cross-functional teams including Operations, Revenue Management, Marketing, Facilities, Accounting, Human Resources, Information Technology, Legal, Devon Executive Leadership, and Inland Acquisitions to coordinate timelines, track deliverables, identify risks, and drive execution.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, systems, and operational requirements. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates effectively with internal and external partners, and takes ownership to ensure a successful transition from beginning to end.
In addition to managing property transitions and dispositions, the Transitions Manager supports operational initiatives, technology implementations, process improvements, and other strategic projects that enhance organizational performance.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:
Property Onboardings

• Lead the onboarding and transition process for newly acquired, newly developed, and third-party managed self-storage properties.

• Serve as the primary project manager and central point of contact throughout the transition lifecycle.

• Develop and maintain project plans, milestone schedules, task lists, and transition timelines.

• Coordinate activities across Operations, Revenue Management, Marketing, Facilities, Accounting, Human Resources, Information Technology, Legal, and other departments.

• Facilitate transition meetings, provide status updates, and ensure accountability for assigned deliverables.

• Monitor risks, identify potential roadblocks, and proactively develop solutions to keep projects on schedule.

• Ensure all operational, financial, technology, marketing, and staffing requirements are completed prior to opening or takeover.

• Coordinate ownership communications and provide regular updates throughout the onboarding process.

• Support post-transition follow-up activities to ensure all outstanding items are completed and the property is successfully integrated.

Property Dispositions

• Lead disposition planning and coordination for properties being sold, transferred, or exiting management.

• Coordinate activities with ownership groups, buyers, legal counsel, operations teams, accounting departments, and third-party stakeholders.

• Develop and manage disposition timelines and project plans.

• Ensure completion of all contractual, operational, financial, technology, and administrative requirements.

• Support the orderly transfer of records, systems, contracts, and operational responsibilities.

• Maintain detailed documentation throughout the disposition process.

Operational Projects & Strategic Initiatives

• Serve as key operator of the Facilities Management System (FMS) and play leadership role in implementation of new technologies, operational tools, and company initiatives.

• Assist with process improvement projects focused on operational efficiency and scalability.

• Coordinate cross-functional projects assigned by executive leadership.

• Document and refining onboarding procedures, transition playbooks, and project management frameworks.

• Identify opportunities to improve transition processes and enhance onboarding experience for property owners and internal stakeholders.

• Support special projects and ad hoc requests as needed.

title: Technical Delivery Manager, Medicaid
description:
For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations. We embed directly in government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.
Your Impact
As the Technical Delivery Manager on the Medicaid team, you bring clarity where it is missing. The team responds to novel analytic questions using Medicaid data, and this role is about listening across policy, technical, and government partner contexts, making sense of what is actually being asked, and turning that into clear decisions, shared expectations, and workable next steps.

As Technical Delivery Manager, you will build trust by identifying tradeoffs early, clarifying decision rights, and following through. This role holds both delivery responsibility for the Medicaid project while lending product skills as well: you work with strong project SMEs to document and support what gets built and when, and you make sure the team has the clarity, coordination, and tools needed to build it well.

The team builds reports for CMS audiences, produced through a data pipeline that draws on national Medicaid data (e.g. T-MSIS). The data science team builds and runs that pipeline in Python and SQL. A policy and program SME provides Medicaid expertise and supports stakeholder relationships. You will not write code or be expected to understand dense policy documents, but you will work close enough to the team to scope work, set priorities, ask the right questions, and represent the work well to stakeholders.
Our Culture
For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means it is okay to run out during the day and pick a child up from school or go for a mid-day walk if it is nice outside.

This position is 100% remote. Our entire team is also entirely remote across the United States, from the west coast to the east coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none.

This position's published base salary range is between $100,000 and $130,000 annually, plus generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Occasional paid travel may be required for on-site collaboration with government partners.

• Build enough working fluency in the team's data and build process to shape and scope requirements the data science team can act on

Temporal customers are building some of the most critical, reliability-sensitive systems in production. They choose Temporal to move faster, ship with confidence, and operate durable workflows at scale.

As a Senior Professional Services Engineer, you will help customers and partners move from design to production-ready execution quickly and safely. You will establish strong delivery patterns, operational standards, and enablement that scale across teams and environments (cloud and self-hosted). This is a delivery-focused role centered on making systems work in the real world, and leaving customers better equipped than when you arrived.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Deliver production-ready Temporal implementations by co-building initial workflows with customer and partner engineering teams

- Implement and teach production-safe workflow patterns, including retries, timeouts, heartbeats, determinism, and versioning

- Identify and remove early activation blockers before they become escalations

- Experience delivering and operating production systems where reliability and incident response matter

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, failure modes, scaling tradeoffs, and operational safety

- Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud and or self-hosted environments

- Ability to design and communicate operational standards, including on-call readiness, runbooks, and capacity planning

- Comfort working directly with customers in high-stakes delivery moments, with a calm and credible approach

- Strong debugging skills and ability to navigate ambiguity and messy real-world constraints

- Ability to teach and enable other engineers, not just deliver the work directly

- Experience with workflow orchestration systems, distributed task processing, or durable execution concepts

- Strong partnership skills to collaborate with product and engineering teams and translate field learnings into roadmap improvements

- Background in working with partners or services delivery models at scale

COMPENSATION

Belay Diagnostics is a ground-breaking and enterprising startup organization focused on the non-invasive detection of central nervous system cancers. Belay has partnered with Johns Hopkins, one of the country’s leading neuro-oncology research centers, to commercialize proprietary molecular technology that will result in faster, more efficient, and less costly answers for patients with suspicious findings. Our goal is to become a neuroscience center of excellence dedicated to the timely, reliable detection of neurological malignancies and disorders. We hope to serve clinicians seeking a fundamentally better solution to suspicious neurological findings as well as partner with other healthcare entities who willleverage our data to develop much-needed therapeutic solutions for brain cancers.

The Business Development Executive is a critical element of the Company’s commercial organization. title: Controls- Technical Lead

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. As a technical lead for controls, you will own the technical direction of our controls stack across its full lifecycle - from 0→1 development on new vehicle platforms to hardening, calibrating, and scaling controllers across production fleets. - Lead, mentor, and grow the existing controls team; set priorities, unblock engineers, and raise the technical bar through design reviews and hands-on collaboration

- Evaluate and apply academic research to create optimal-control-based solutions using techniques like nonlinear MPC and MPPI control

- Collaborate with customers' engineers in construction, mining, and agriculture, and manage those relationships through field deployments

- Passion for tackling challenging control problems involving a wide array of vehicles in varied and unstructured environments

- 6+ years of experi

title: Trainee / Berufseinstieg nach BWL-, Finance- oder Wirtschaftsrecht-Studium (m/w/d)
description:
DEINE ROLLE

Der Berufseinstieg entscheidet, wie schnell du wirklich etwas kannst. Bei Vogel bekommst du direkt nach dem Studium mehr als Zuarbeit: Du arbeitest von Tag eins an echten Mandaten, kommst früh in den direkten Kontakt mit Geschäftsführern mittelständischer Unternehmen und lernst Beratung dort, wo sie am meisten zählt - nah am Mandanten.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften Deutschlands - mehrere Tausend Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Unsere Arbeit läuft in drei Linien mit jeweils eigener Verantwortung: Steuerberatung, Accounting & Controlling und Digitalisierungsberatung. Genau deshalb können wir dir etwas anbieten, das sonst kaum jemand hat - du musst dich nicht vorher entscheiden.

Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor - Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Steuerrecht, Wirtschaftsrecht oder ein vergleichbares Fach. Deine ersten zwölf Monate sind bewusst offen: Du arbeitest je rund vier Monate in der Steuerberatung, in Accounting & Controlling und in der Digitalisierungsberatung - jeweils mit eigenen Mandaten und eigener Verantwortung, nicht als Zuschauer. Am Ende dieses Jahres entscheidest du gemeinsam mit uns, wo dein Schwerpunkt liegt. Vogel unterstützt dich anschließend beim passenden Qualifikationsschritt - Master, Führungskarriere oder Berufsexamen, je nach Richtung. Der Weg führt in beiden Linien über eigene Mandate in die Führung eines eigenen Teams.

DEINE VERANTWORTUNG

Steuerberatung

- Beurteile, wo Handelsrecht und Steuerrecht auseinanderlaufen, und bereite die Steuererklärungen für Gesellschaften und Unternehmerfamilien vor - mit eigener Verantwortung und Review durch deinen Anleiter.

- Begleite Bescheidprüfungen, Rechtsbehelfe und Betriebsprüfungen und lern dabei, wo im Steuerrecht die eigentlichen Streitpunkte liegen.

- Wirk in gestaltender Beratung mit - Umwandlungen, Nachfolgeplanung, Strukturierung. Hier siehst du, dass Steuerberatung im Kern Denkarbeit ist.

Accounting & Controlling

- Trag eigene Mandate im laufenden Rechnungswesen, geh den Auffälligkeiten nach und wirk an Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit.

- Bereite die BWA-Besprechung mit dem Unternehmer vor und erklär, was die Zahlen tatsächlich aussagen.

- Arbeite an Forecasts, Planungs- und Liquiditätsbetrachtungen mit - dort, wo die Zahlen anfangen, unternehmerische Fragen zu beantworten.

Digitalisierungsberatung und eigene Werkzeuge

- Implementiere beim Mandanten Systeme und richte sie ein - Schnittstellen, Belegflüsse, die Anbindung an sein Vorsystem. Du sitzt beim Unternehmen und bringst die Technik zum Laufen.

- Betreue Mandanten, die selbst buchen, und schul ihr Personal an den Werkzeugen, mit denen gearbeitet wird.

- Nutz KI selbstverständlich für Recherche, Analyse, Drafting und Plausibilisierung, und bring eigene Ideen ein, wie Mandantenarbeit schneller und besser wird. Wer KI als Bedrohung sieht, ist hier falsch.

DEINE PERSPEKTIVEN

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
description:

By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health 's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap-encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability-while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform-ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.
As a Director of Engineering, Data Products , you will:

• Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.

• Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.

• Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.

• Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.

• Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards.

Success in this role looks like:

• Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.

• Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.

• Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities

• Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.

You should get in touch if:

• You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).

• Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.

• Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments.

• Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.

• Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.

• Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.

• Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.

• Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.

• Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.

• Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.

title: Medical Director - Oncology , Sponsor Dedicated (Home-Based)
description:
Job Overview
The medical department consists of a Chief Medical Officer, Medical Directors, Sr Medical Directors, Medical Writers, and Safety Associates. The Medical Director provides medical and scientific support to clinical research programs, study teams and investigators. The Medical Director also provides review, advice, and leadership for potentially or awarded clinical research programs.
The Medical Director role is a team member participant role and functions in a matrix report to project teams much like other members of the project teams. The primary role of Medical Director is to provide medical oversight for clinical trials by serving as Medical Monitor for studies conducted by IQVIA Biotech Clinical on behalf of sponsor companies. The principal function of a Medical Monitor is to serve as primary contact for the sponsor medical team and to serve as front line medical resource to support the project team. The Medical Monitor is customarily available 24/7 to answer questions from site coordinators and investigators on protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria, protocol clarifications, and compliance issues, and to provide review of alert labs per sponsor preference. Major duties of the Medical Director are outlined below:
Essential Functions
Functions as project team member:

• Provides medical and scientific input to clinical research programs including review of new business proposals, preclinical and/or clinical data, study protocols, training materials, informed consent, Investigator Drug Brochures, eCRFs, analysis plan designs, clinical study reports, regulatory approval submissions, serious and non-serious adverse event evaluation, and reporting.

• Ensures medical activities run according to GCP and operate with highest efficiency.

• Establishes and maintains a network of medical/scientific consultants, etc.

• Supervises and manages Medical Director activities.

Mission
The Vice President, Channel and Partner Programs will lead CenTrak's Channel and Partner team, owning the strategy, structure, governance, enablement, and performance of CenTrak's partner ecosystem. This leader will design and operate a scalable partner program that increases partner-sourced and partner-influenced growth, improves partner accountability, strengthens executive-level partner relationships, and creates a consistent operating model across partner types, regions, and internal teams.
This highly visible role balances program leadership, partner enablement, channel governance, strategic relationship management, and partner-led growth. The role requires strong collaboration across US Sales, Strategic Accounts, International Sales, Sales Operations, Product, Marketing, Services, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and executive leadership.

This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing Channel and Partner organization focused on scalable growth, partner productivity, operational discipline, and customer value. title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

You're the second person in, owning events and content.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. The stories sit with underwriting, distribution and product, so getting good material out of busy people is a big part of the job.

AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. We want you to be the person who brings the newest tool into the office and shows everyone what it does. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own social media. Run our social strategy, with LinkedIn as the primary channel: product videos, carousels, infographics, and PDF’s, posted consistently and measured for engagement.

- Create content at volume. Case studies, articles, industry news, thought leadership and product launch material, several times a month.

- Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

- Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

- Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

- Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

- A portfolio of work you can share on the spot.

- Strong copywriting and communication, proven in published work.

- A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

- Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

- Startup pace and ownership: you've worked somewhere small enough to own outcomes end to end, spot what needs improving and act without waiting for a brief.

- Confident, critical use of AI across your marketing work.

Nice to have: video editing experience, and exposure to insurance, fleet or telematics.
